summary: THE EXLPLORERS WE LEFT BEHIND transforms abandoned space hardware into a story of exploration and legacy. From the Moon to Mars and deep space, robotic explorers travelled where humans can't, collecting discoveries that changed our understanding of the universe. Though some now stand silent, their stories continue to inspire the next generation to ask : "What will we be sending next?" .
details: We usually see abandoned space hardware as objects left behind. Our story asks us to see them differently :as explorers whose missions ended, but whose discoveries continue humanity's journey.
